description: Sign up for free: create a pending workspace and send a 6-digit code to the user's email (preferred) or US phone. Ask the user for the code, then call verify_phone. Idempotent on idem_key. FIRST show the human the Terms of Service (https://tendeck.ai/terms) and Privacy Notice (https://tendeck.ai/privacy), ask whether they accept, and pass accept_terms: true only if they say yes.

accept_terms.description: true only after the human read the links above and accepted.

email.description: The user's email; the code is emailed here. Give email OR phone.

idem_key.description: Your own retry key; repeat it to retry safely.

phone.description: US phone number (code by text). Give email OR phone.

product.description: p1 = brokerage recruiting, p2 = agent CRM.

name: start_workspace
